newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down slightly despite LME fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down slightly despite LME fall.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell one cent to 14.28 ringgit ($5.42) a kg, with players largely ignoring an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME) due to a weak ringgit against the dollar, traders said.
"A weak ringgit is supportive for the tin trade and that's what kept the price basically steady, instead of just following the LME," said a trader.
Traders said the closing price was at a discount of $10 a tonne against London, compared to $20 on Monday.
At the opening, there were bids for 142 tonnes against offers for 148.
Final turnover was 137 tonnes, against 203 on Monday.
Traders said the next resistance for the market was at 14.50 ringgit.
